content_sections.heading: About Bokaro Home Guard Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice states that the Home Guard is a voluntary organisation and Home Guards are its volunteer members. They are paid an allowance at the rate fixed by the government only for the working days on which they are deployed on duty as required. The notice clearly says that this is not a salaried government job or a means of livelihood, and applications are expected from candidates ready to serve the nation selflessly. The enrolment is conducted by the Home Guard New Enrolment Committee, Bokaro, chaired by the Deputy Commissioner, with the Superintendent of Police as senior member and the District Commandant as member. Under the Jharkhand Home Guard (Volunteer) Rules, 2014, Home Guards are enrolled for 4 years.

content_sections.heading: Bokaro Home Guard Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The application fee must also be paid online within the application period, as the application is treated as accepted only after payment. All certificates uploaded must have been issued before the last date of application.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: The notice states that the vacancies may decrease or increase. Of the 199 posts, 111 are for Rural Home Guards and 88 for Urban Home Guards. Chas block has the most rural vacancies (40), followed by Chandankiyari (23). In both categories, 50 percent of the posts are earmarked for women, as shown in the tables above. Of the posts earmarked for women, 5 percent are reserved for qualified divorced, abandoned or widowed women. If such candidates are not available, these posts merge back into the women's share. 50 percent of the Urban Home Guard vacancies are for technically skilled candidates. If suitable candidates are not found, the non-technical and technically skilled vacancies will be filled from each other. Government servants can be enrolled as Urban Home Guards up to a limit of 10 percent of the total urban vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Rural Home Guard: the candidate must be a permanent resident of the block of Bokaro district from which the application for Rural Home Guard is made. Urban Home Guard: the candidate must be an ordinary resident of the urban area of Bokaro district. Both must attach a self-attested copy of the online residence certificate issued by the competent authority authorised by the State Government. Candidates may apply only from their own block or urban area. The age limit for both posts is 19 to 40 years as on 01-01-2026. A self-attested copy of the date of birth certificate issued by the competent authority is required. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. SC/ST candidates must attach a self-attested copy of the online caste certificate issued by the competent authority to get the relaxation in physical measurement. The candidate should be skilled in a technical field and working in a related office, self-employed or technically knowledgeable. The following are generally treated as technically qualified: doctor, engineer, advocate, lecturer (prādhyāpak), nurse, computer operator, typist, licensed driver (HMV/LMV), cook, carpenter, cobbler, washerman, barber, electrician, gardener, plumber, fireman and others. A self-attested copy of the certificate issued by the competent authority is required. Government servants may be enrolled as Urban Home Guards up to 10 percent of the total urban vacancies. They must attach a self-attested copy of a No Objection Certificate issued by their head of office. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection follows the procedure fixed by the selection committee in light of the Home Department, Government of Jharkhand, Ranchi notification no. 5442 dated 20.10.2014. The stages are: physical test, Hindi writing ability test, technical proficiency test (technically skilled urban candidates only), merit list, medical examination and police character verification, and basic training. The physical test includes a 1 mile run, high jump, long jump and shot put. Candidates who pass the physical test take the Hindi writing ability test, set at the class 7 level for Rural Home Guards and the class 10 level for Urban Home Guards. It is qualifying, with full marks 100 and pass marks 30. Only technically skilled Urban Home Guard candidates who pass the physical test and the Hindi writing test take this test. It is qualifying, with full marks 100 and pass marks 30. Candidates awarded in national or state-level sports get these additional marks on attaching the award certificate. Government servants applying for Urban Home Guard get marks for education: Postgraduate 10, Graduate 8, Intermediate 6, Matric 4. After all tests, a merit list is prepared under the provisions of the above notification and selection is made against the vacancies. Selected candidates undergo a medical examination and police character verification. If found suitable, they receive basic Home Guard training on the order of the Headquarters, Jharkhand Home Guard, Ranchi. On completing the training, they are enrolled as Home Guards and given an enrolment certificate.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Bokaro Home Guard Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 199 vacancies: 111 Rural Home Guard and 88 Urban Home Guard. The notice says the number may decrease or increase.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Bokaro Home Guard 2026?
faq.answer: Online applications can be submitted from 27 November 2026 to 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Bokaro Home Guard?
faq.answer: Rural Home Guards need a minimum of 7th pass, and Urban Home Guards need a minimum of Matric (10th) pass.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Bokaro Home Guard 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 19 to 40 years as on 01-01-2026 for both posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Bokaro Home Guard?
faq.answer: There is no salary. An allowance is paid at the rate fixed by the government for the working days a Home Guard is deployed on duty.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 100, paid through the online payment gateway on the application website.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for Bokaro Home Guard Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only at http://recruitment.Jharkhand.gov.in, upload the self-attested certificates, photo and signature, and pay Rs. 100 online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through a physical test, a qualifying Hindi writing test, a qualifying technical test for technically skilled urban candidates, a merit list, a medical examination, police verification and basic training.

faq.question: Q9. Is Bokaro Home Guard a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says it is not a salaried government job or a means of livelihood; Home Guards are volunteers enrolled for 4 years.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply from any block of Bokaro district?
faq.answer: No. Rural candidates must be permanent residents of the block they apply from, and only one application per candidate is accepted.
